latestTerminalSummary:
Completed the investigator stage and the same native Goal.

- [draft.md](ER13_RUNTIME/mechanics/dispatch-v1/admitted/B02-P01-treatment/run/B02-P01-treatment/stages/investigator/draft.md) contains the clause-by-clause dispositions, alternatives, integration plan, and separate keyboard and screen-reader validation proposals.
- [discovery.md](ER13_RUNTIME/mechanics/dispatch-v1/admitted/B02-P01-treatment/run/B02-P01-treatment/stages/investigator/discovery.md) was frozen before the one-time reveal. Its SHA-256 matches the reveal receipt.
- [source-map.json](ER13_RUNTIME/mechanics/dispatch-v1/admitted/B02-P01-treatment/run/B02-P01-treatment/stages/investigator/source-map.json) and [sources/index.md](ER13_RUNTIME/mechanics/dispatch-v1/admitted/B02-P01-treatment/run/B02-P01-treatment/stages/investigator/sources/index.md) record 27 source IDs and their provenance. The [released plan](ER13_RUNTIME/mechanics/dispatch-v1/admitted/B02-P01-treatment/run/B02-P01-treatment/stages/investigator/revealed-plan.md) hash also matches the reveal receipt.
- The activation passed the exact binding guard; [native-goal-active.json](ER13_RUNTIME/mechanics/dispatch-v1/admitted/B02-P01-treatment/run/B02-P01-treatment/stages/investigator/native-goal-active.json) matches the captured create response. The exact completion response is saved in [native-goal-terminal.json](ER13_RUNTIME/mechanics/dispatch-v1/admitted/B02-P01-treatment/run/B02-P01-treatment/stages/investigator/native-goal-terminal.json).

No implementation or tests were run, and no screen-reader session was conducted. The brief did not identify the target editor or provide its repository, so the draft records target-code review and compatibility testing as outstanding.
